description: Land Acquisition - The Revocation Order under Section 39(A)(1) of the Land Acquisition Act published Gaz. No. 2267/59 dated 13.02.2022. Revocation under Section 39(1)
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land acquisition matters, specifically the cancellation and revocation of land acquisition orders under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and assessment numbers. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content focuses on land-related administrative actions rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
